title: AI Workflow Automation Templates Pack: 20 Ready-to-Use Zapier, Make & n8n Templates
author: Malaclyde
excerpt: Stop building automations from scratch. This pack gives you 20 copy-paste templates for Zapier, Make, and n8n. Save 100+ hours of setup time.
content:
Building automations is powerful but time-consuming. Every Zap, scenario, or workflow requires trial and error, testing, and debugging. What if you could skip all that?

This pack gives you 20 battle-tested automation templates that work out of the box. Copy the configuration, connect your accounts, and you're live in minutes.

Content Automation (5 templates)

1. Blog-to-Social-Media Pipeline: Publish a blog post → AI generates social variants → auto-schedules across Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook.

2. RSS-to-Newsletter: New RSS item → AI summarizes → adds to email template → sends to subscribers.

3. Video-to-Blog Post: Upload video → AI transcribes → reformats as blog → publishes draft.

4. Podcast-to-Show Notes: New episode → AI generates summary, timestamps, key quotes → posts to website.

5. Content Calendar Sync: Google Calendar event → creates Notion database entry → assigns tasks.

Lead Generation (5 templates)

Website form to CRM, social media lead capture, webinar registration flow, referral program tracker, and lead scoring automation. Each captures, qualifies, and routes leads automatically.

Customer Success (5 templates)

Onboarding sequence (7-day email series), support ticket routing by category, NPS feedback collection with follow-ups, churn prevention alerts, and upsell recommendations based on usage.

Operations (5 templates)

Auto invoice generation, meeting scheduler with confirmation, document generator (contracts/proposals), automated data backup, and weekly reporting dashboard.

Compatible with: Zapier, Make (formerly Integromat), and n8n. Each template includes: step-by-step setup instructions, JSON configuration files, video walkthrough links, customization guide, and troubleshooting FAQ.

Get the Templates Pack →
description: 20 ready-to-use automation templates for Zapier, Make, and n8n. Copy-paste configurations. Save 100+ hours. Content, leads, customer success, and operations.
